question.title: Guest Book Cleanup
question.content:
An inn keeps a guest book. Each element of pages is one page, listing the signatures on it from top to bottom. A forgetful guest sometimes signs the same page twice.

Return the pages in their original order, where each page keeps only the first signature of each name, with the remaining signatures in their original order. A name may appear on several pages, and each page is judged alone.

 

Example 1:

Input: pages = [["ana","bo","ana"],["cy"]]
Output: [["ana","bo"],["cy"]]
Explanation: The second signature of ana is dropped from the first page.

Example 2:

Input: pages = [["Doe, Jo","Lee, Max","Doe, Jo"]]
Output: [["Doe, Jo","Lee, Max"]]
Explanation: A signature may contain a comma.

Example 3:

Input: pages = [["kim","kim"],["raj","uma","raj","kim"]]
Output: [["kim"],["raj","uma","kim"]]

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= pages.length <= 100
  • 1 <= pages[i].length <= 50
  • Signatures contain letters, spaces, and commas.
